'''Regional Prefects''' were positions within the [[Colonial Government]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. Each Regional Prefect ruled over a single [[o'beki]] in conjunction with the local [[P'Dar'Ib]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Del Obarren]] was the Regional Prefect of [[A'Lenba]].
